Samuel Achterberg-Osei
Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Engineer | Azure | Terraform
[EMAIL] | [PHONE]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Cloud infrastructure engineer with more than eight years of IT experience, including hands-on work designing and operating Azure infrastructure, Terraform modules, Azure DevOps pipelines, and AKS. Built Azure hub-and-spoke networking across three subscriptions and automated deployments for 15 internal applications. Earlier systems administration experience includes Windows and Linux servers, VMware, and a 60-server Azure migration completed over six weekends without unplanned downtime.

CORE SKILLS
Cloud and infrastructure as code: Microsoft Azure, Terraform, Azure landing zones, Azure Migrate, Azure VMs
Networking: Hub-and-spoke networks, Azure Firewall, VNet peering, private DNS zones, private endpoints, site-to-site VPN
DevOps and containers: Azure DevOps YAML pipelines, Docker, AKS operations, Helm, App Service
Systems administration: Windows and Linux servers, VMware, Proxmox
Automation and testing: PowerShell, Python (small scripts), Go (Terratest tests), Terratest, drift detection
Security: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, MFA, conditional access, mailbox auditing, backups

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Cloud Engineer (Contract) | Havenstad Logistics | 2025–Present
- Build Azure landing-zone infrastructure and Terraform modules, including hub-and-spoke networking across three subscriptions.
- Implement Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for 15 internal .NET and Node applications, deploying to App Service or AKS; deployment frequency increased from roughly monthly to several times per week for most applications.
- Operate AKS, including upgrades, node pools, and ingress; application manifests are owned by developers.
- Add Terratest module tests to the pipeline and a nightly infrastructure drift-detection job.
- Contract scheduled to end February 2027.

Systems Administrator | Maasbrug Gemeente IT Services | 2014–2020
- Administered around 250 Windows and Linux servers and supported staff across several municipal services.
- Planned and executed the migration of 60 servers from VMware to Azure IaaS using Azure Migrate; completed cutover over six weekends with no unplanned downtime.
- Used PowerShell to automate repetitive administrative work.

Freelance IT Support | 2022–2023
- Created a repeatable PowerShell script and checklist for small-business Microsoft 365 security baselines, including MFA, conditional access, mailbox auditing, and backups.

CAREER BREAKS AND PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT
Family caregiving | March 2020–August 2022
- Took time away from paid work to provide full-time care for a family member; maintained Azure Administrator Associate knowledge and provided unpaid IT help to a church and family.

Independent study and cloud training | February 2024–February 2025
- Completed a part-time, online, English-language cloud bootcamp in December 2024.
- Studied Terraform and built a Proxmox homelab; passed the Terraform Associate certification in 2025.

CERTIFICATIONS
Azure Administrator Associate
Terraform Associate (2025)
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Cloud Infrastructure / DevOps Contractor role supporting Corvale Mobility’s fleet connectivity platform. My recent work combines Azure infrastructure design, Terraform, networking, and production deployment automation—experience I can bring to the challenge of building and operating the cloud platform for Corvale’s new generation of trains.

At Havenstad Logistics, I built Terraform-based Azure landing-zone networking across three subscriptions, using Azure Firewall, private DNS zones, private endpoints, and VNet peering. I added Terratest module tests and nightly drift detection. I also replaced manual deployments for 15 internal .NET and Node applications with Azure DevOps YAML pipelines for App Service and AKS, increasing deployment frequency for most applications from roughly monthly to several times per week. I operate AKS, including upgrades, node pools, and ingress.

Earlier, I planned and executed a VMware-to-Azure migration of 60 servers, completing cutover over six weekends without unplanned downtime. My cloud infrastructure experience is Azure-based, and my background also includes Windows and Linux systems administration and practical Microsoft 365 security work. I would bring this infrastructure and delivery experience to Corvale’s work on reliable, secure train-to-cloud services.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience in Azure infrastructure, Terraform, networking, and deployment automation could contribute to the fleet connectivity team.

Kind regards,
Samuel Achterberg-Osei
